title: Scientists reconstruct face of 'Conquest Man,' skeleton from 1079 burial
summary_full: Buried around 1079, Conquest Man's identity has been revealed through scientific analysis. His ancestry offers insights into his journey across Europe, showcasing a unique blend of Scandinavian artifacts with those linked to a Norman church. This finding complicates the simplistic Saxon versus Norman narrative, emphasizing resilience and adaptability in the aftermath of the Norman Conquest.
